lesson.subtitle: Lesson 21 -- What Are You Going to Do? Plans with the People You Travel With
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Leão | Lesson 21 -- What Are You Going to Do?

listenings.text: Good evening, everybody. Here is the plan for tomorrow. We are going to meet at the hotel door at eight thirty. First, we are going to walk to the old town, and I am going to show you the famous square. At eleven, we are going to take the ferry to the island. It is twenty minutes. We are going to have lunch there, in a small fish restaurant. In the afternoon you are free. Some people are going to visit the museum, some people are going to rest. And at seven, if the weather is good, we are going to watch the sunset from the bridge. Please bring a jacket. It is going to be cold.

This summer my family and I are going to travel together, the four of us. We are not going to stay in a big hotel. We are going to rent a small house near the sea, in the south of Italy. My daughter is going to study Italian before the trip, because she wants to talk to people. My son is not going to study anything. He is going to swim and eat pizza, that is his plan. And me? I am not going to answer emails. I am going to rent a bike, read two books and watch the sunset every evening. That is my plan.

extra_audio.text: At nine we are going to rent two bikes. Then we are going to go sightseeing in the old town. At twelve thirty we are going to take the ferry. In the afternoon Claire is going to visit the museum. In the evening we are going to watch the sunset.
